name: AnalyzepRF on volume
summary: An app to do a population receptive field analysis on HCP 7T retinotopy fMRI data

parameters.description: Perform slice-timing and head motion correction on fMRI if not already preprocessed
Repetition time of fMRI (read from the nii header if unspecified)
Conversion factor from pixels to degrees subtended for visual stimulus (16 deg / 200 px for HCP data)
Specifies whether global signal regression (GSR) on input fMRI should be done, conversion to % change from baseline

options.label: per-voxel normalization
options.description: regresses out mean signal per voxel

parameters.description:
Use seedmode -2 and perform very quick PRF analysis

% - When <seedmode> is -2, optimization is not performed and instead the best seed based on the super-grid is returned as the final estimate.

seedmode 0:
% - The first seed is a generic large pRF that is centered with respect to the stimulus, has a pRF size equal to 1/4th of the stimulus extent (thus, +/- 2 pRF sizes matches the stimulus extent), and has an exponent of 0.5.

seedmode 1:
% - The second seed is a generic small pRF that is just like the first seed except has a pRF size that is 10 times smaller.

seedmode 2:
% - The third seed is a "supergrid" seed that is identified by performing a quick grid search prior to optimization (similar in spirit to methods described in Dumoulin and Wandell, 2008).  In this procedure, a list of potential seeds is constructed by 
%   exploring a range of eccentricities, angles, and exponents.  For each potential 
%   seed, the model prediction is computed, and the seed that produces the closest 
%   match to the data is identified.
